engineDivergence.engineDivergence: Three engine siblings. modern stamps seventeen parts spanning a trigger surface (root, trigger-input, clear-button, clock-icon, separator) and a detached panel (popup, panel, header, column-label, label-separator, columns, column-divider, time-column, time-option, footer, now-button, extra-footer), and the modern skin styles every one of them. The panel is a portalled surface reachable only through the .rottay-timepicker__panel class, stamped at packages/core/src/ui/primitives/inputs/TimePicker/engines/modern/index.tsx:229 and repeated twice inside the skin selector purely to raise specificity - the skin says so in its own header comment at packages/core/src/foundation/tokens/css/runtime/engines/modern/skin/time-picker.css:57. rustic stamps only the five trigger-side parts and carries panel geometry inline (engines/rustic/index.tsx:30-357); the rustic skin styles just clear-button, clock-icon, separator and trigger-input, leaving even the rustic root unpainted by rustic CSS. classic wraps antd TimePicker. packages/core/src/foundation/tokens/css/runtime/engines/modern/skin/date-picker.css mentions rottay-timepicker only inside comments and is NOT a paint owner for this family.
